name: Block IP Range via iptables
description: Block a range of attacker IPs (e.g., 172.18.0.10-210) detected by PMP on the victim firewall via SSH. Single command blocks all IPs in the range.

__ip_range_start__.name: __ip_range_start__
__ip_range_start__.description: Start IP of the range to block (e.g., 172.18.0.10).

__ip_range_end__.name: __ip_range_end__
__ip_range_end__.description: End IP of the range to block (e.g., 172.18.0.210).

action--286b9b45-5414-4597-8420-69292364.name: Block attacker IP range via iptables
action--286b9b45-5414-4597-8420-69292364.description: Uses SSH to run iptables on the victim and drop all traffic from the attacker IP range using -m iprange for efficiency.

commands.command:
sudo -n sh -lc 'printf "#!/bin/sh
sleep 0
iptables -C INPUT -m iprange --src-range __ip_range_start__:value-__ip_range_end__:value -j DROP 2>/dev/null || iptables -A INPUT -m iprange --src-range __ip_range_start__:value-__ip_range_end__:value -j DROP
iptables -C OUTPUT -m iprange --dst-range __ip_range_start__:value-__ip_range_end__:value -j DROP 2>/dev/null || iptables -A OUTPUT -m iprange --dst-range __ip_range_start__:value-__ip_range_end__:value -j DROP
" > /tmp/_block_range.sh && chmod +x /tmp/_block_range.sh && setsid sh /tmp/_block_range.sh </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo novadef_countermeasure_applied'

linux--daea220d-6e61-4210-8794-fe3a99fac.name: scenario_victim
linux--daea220d-6e61-4210-8794-fe3a99fac.description: Victim machine where iptables will be applied.
